RESIDENTE — Advisory at Ruta
Signal level and language are live tweaks on the home artboard: switch Signal 1-5 or Tagalog / Cebuano / English to see the whole screen re-colour and re-word.

RESIDENTE — SOS at Pag-uulat
SOS shows queue position and the assigned team. The report form uses a body-referenced depth picker instead of a dropdown.

VOLUNTEER — Check-in at Headcount
Triage tags carry colour weight. Counter controls sit in the thumb zone, sized for wet or gloved hands.

RESPONDER AT OPISYAL — Live Rescue at Protocols (desktop)
The rescue queue is sorted by wait time with the oldest unanswered request escalated to a banner. Protocols are a Purok x Signal coverage matrix so gaps are visible at a glance.

PAGPASOK AT PAGKAKAKILANLAN — Onboarding, Device & Role, Profile, Reports (Q5)
Two questions and no account: language, then Purok. Device & Role replaces the 'sign-in screen' Q5 asked for — anonymous auth means there is no login, so the screen a volunteer actually needs is the one showing the code an official adds to the roster.

SANGGUNIAN — Centers, Paghahanda, Gabay (Q5)
The directory pins the resident's own assigned centre above the list. The checklist counts against the leave-by deadline rather than showing a bare percentage. Every guide article is precached — a guide that needs a connection is useless in the situation it describes.
